inputs.text: Health workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations took to the streets at Unity Fountain in Maitama, Abuja, on Thursday to oppose reform bills before the National Assembly. Their protest is a warning that decisions about healthcare cannot be made over the heads of the people who deliver it. Lawmakers should listen to workers and put the needs of patients and frontline staff ahead of reforms that risk deepening an already unequal system.
